subject: MAP: Marketplace eval -> procurement path & invoice routing (NovaCorp)
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@novacorp.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@novacorp.com>
Date: Fri, 01 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP request & procurement questions for GCP/AWS private offers

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for last week's demo — the team was impressed with the latency numbers and the billing visibility. Procurement asked me to pull together a short MAP (mutual action plan) so we can align evaluation checkpoints, legal review, and invoice routing for the AWS & GCP marketplace private offers.

High level asks from our side:
- A week-by-week evaluation plan we can share with engineering (10–20 node test), with acceptance criteria.
- Who at Redwood will be the billing contact for marketplace invoices? We need invoice-to and remit-to details for our AP system.
- Any TAR/PO numbering requirements for Marketplace private offers (we use PO# on invoices).
- Do you support invoice consolidation across cloud providers or will we receive separate invoices per marketplace?

Can you send a draft MAP and a short diagram of the invoice flow? Procurement wants this before their 06/07 review.

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Head of Cloud Integrations
NovaCorp

Attachment: procurement_requirements_novacorp.xlsx (referenced)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@novacorp.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 01 Jun 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP request & procurement questions for GCP/AWS private offers

Hi Elena — great to connect. Please find an initial MAP draft attached; I built it around a 4-week evaluation cadence with clear acceptance gates and owners. Quick answers inline and a few open items that need your confirmation: 

Inline: 
- Billing contact: Jordan Blake (billing@redwood.ai). Jordan will receive marketplace invoices and coordinate remit-to.
- PO requirements: We can include your PO# on all invoices. For AWS Private Offers we can map their invoice metadata to the PO field; for GCP we will include PO# in the invoice PDF header. Confirm the exact PO prefix you need.
- Invoice consolidation: Currently separate invoices per marketplace are standard (AWS vs GCP). We can request consolidation but it requires a marketplace-level merchant change and typically takes 6–8 weeks.

Open items for NovaCorp: 
- Confirm if you require a single invoice recipient for all cloud providers or separate recipients per provider.
- Legal SOW vs. Marketplace offer — do you need a separate SOW signature before marketplace acceptance?

Attached: nova_map_draft_v1.pdf, invoice-routing-diagram.png

Next step: if the MAP looks good I'll slot a 30-min alignment call Monday 06/04 to lock owners and the PO format.

— Tessa Morgan
Sr. Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0187

Attachment stubs: nova_map_draft_v1.pdf (12 pages); invoice-routing-diagram.png (1 image)

From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@novacorp.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: NovaCorp Procurement <procurement@novacorp.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@novacorp.com>
Date: Mon, 04 Jun 2028 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP request & procurement questions for GCP/AWS private offers

Thanks Tessa — we reviewed the draft. A few clarifications from procurement: 
- NovaCorp will use PO prefix NC-2028 for this engagement; include NC-2028-#### on all invoices.
- We prefer separate invoices per marketplace (one AWS invoice, one GCP invoice) for tracking. Consolidation isn't necessary.
- Legal: Procurement needs the marketplace commercial terms plus a short SOW that references the private offer and acceptance criteria. We can sign the SOW via DocuSign.

Accept the Monday 06/04 10:00am PT alignment call. Samir from procurement will lead the invoice routing questions.

Elena

Elena / Samir — great to meet you on the call. Follow-up actions from Redwood: 
- I'll be the billing contact and will ensure PO NC-2028-#### is on both AWS and GCP invoices.
- Redeploy: we will issue separate invoices per marketplace as requested.
- On remit: Redwood's remit-to is: Redwood Inference, Attn: Accounts Receivable, PO Box 4201, San Francisco, CA 94107. Electronic payments to payments@redwood.ai (ACH instructions in the invoice footer).
- Timeline: procurement checksum — we will target first evaluation invoice after acceptance (estimated invoice date 2028-07-01).

Action items for NovaCorp: 
1) Confirm DocuSign SOW signers (name + email).
2) Confirm whether AP requires a specific invoice metadata field beyond PO (e.g., project code).

I've attached the invoice-routing-diagram.png and a sample invoice header for marketplace invoices. Also attaching a short SLA exception request document in case NovaCorp needs an SLA commitment tied to billing cadence.

— Jordan Blake
Director, Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: sample-invoice-header.pdf; redwood-sla-exception-request.docx

Jordan/Tessa — confirming next steps from NovaCorp: 
- DocuSign SOW signers: Samir Patel (samir.patel@novacorp.com) and Elena Morales (elena.morales@novacorp.com).
- AP: we only need PO and project code; project code will be PC-NOVA-47. Please include PC-NOVA-47 as an invoice line metadata field if possible.
- Acceptance criteria: engineering will run the 10–20 node eval for 2 weeks; acceptance is defined by 95th percentile latency under 150ms and no more than 0.5% error rate on model responses.

Once you confirm the invoice metadata and send the DocuSign link for the SOW, we'll route to Legal and AP for sign-off.

Thanks,
Samir
Senior Procurement Manager, NovaCorp
